summary.text: Woody Wordekemper is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 15, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Woody Wordekemper's occupation as a firefighter and paramedic.

paragraphs.text: Woody Wordekemper was born on January 24, 1966, in West Point.
Woody Wordekemper graduated from West Point Central Catholic High School in 1984 and earned an associate degree in fire science from Virginia Western Community College in 1993.
Woody Wordekemper is a member of the Nebraska Professional Firefighters Association and the International Association of Firefighters.
Woody Wordekemper is married to Barbara, and they have two children.
